    SELECT i_item_sk 
    FROM item 
    WHERE i_manufact_id = 816
)

       item.i_brand_id brand_id,
       item.i_brand brand,
       SUM(ss.sales_price) sum_agg

JOIN store_sales ON ss_sold_date_sk = dt.d_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
JOIN item_filter ON i_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
WHERE dt.d_moy = 11
GROUP BY dyear, brand_id, brand
ORDER BY dyear DESC, sum_agg DESC, brand_id LIMIT 100
